SELECT h.symbol, h.qty, h.avg_cost, MAX(ss.snapshot_date) AS latest_snapshot_date
FROM portfolio.holdings AS h
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots AS ss ON h.symbol = ss.symbol
GROUP BY h.symbol, h.qty, h.avg_cost
ORDER BY ss.snapshot_date DESC;
